// Per-channel sampler settings (Shadertoy filter / wrap / vflip), set with directives.
// Thirds, left to right:
//   1. a sharp 4x4 checker, red square top-left        (nearest)
//   2. the same image soft and tiled 2x2               (linear, repeat)
//   3. sharp again but upside down: red square bottom-left (nearest, vflip=false)
// ffstudio: iChannel0 = img/grid4.png filter=nearest wrap=clamp
// ffstudio: iChannel1 = img/grid4.png filter=linear wrap=repeat
// ffstudio: iChannel2 = img/grid4.png filter=nearest vflip=false
void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = fragCoord / iResolution.xy;
    float x = uv.x * 3.0;
    if (x < 1.0)
        fragColor = texture(iChannel0, vec2(x, uv.y));
    else if (x < 2.0)
        fragColor = texture(iChannel1, vec2(x - 1.0, uv.y) * 2.0);
    else
        fragColor = texture(iChannel2, vec2(x - 2.0, uv.y));
}
